# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## I. By Primary Task Type

### A. Loop Drawing
*Draw a single continuous loop through cells or along grid lines.*

#### i. Simple Loop (no special symbol interaction beyond constraints)
- **Masyu** — loop constrained by black/white circle turning rules
- **Mid-loop** — loop constrained by black circles as midpoints of straight segments
- **Slitherlink** — loop drawn on grid edges, constrained by numeric cell clues

#### ii. Loop with Regional/Room Constraints
- **Dotchi-Loop** — loop through cells; white circles in each bold-line area must all be straight or all be turns; avoids black circles
- **Moon-or-Sun** — loop through rooms visiting either all moons or all suns per room, alternating between rooms
- **Suraromu** — loop starts/ends at numbered circle, must cross all "gates" between black cells in specified order

#### iii. Loop with Directional/Flow Constraints
- **Nagareru** — directional loop; arrows establish loop direction; wind arrows constrain movement against/across wind

#### iv. Loop Combined with Shading
- **Yajilin** — draw a loop and place black cells; arrow-number clues constrain black cell counts; black cells cannot touch

---

### B. Path/Line Drawing (Not Necessarily a Loop)

- **Numberlink** — connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing, non-branching paths
- **Hashiwokakero** — connect island-circles with 1–2 bridges; all islands connected; bridges cannot cross
- **Pencils** — identify pencil shapes and draw lines from tips through a specified number of cells
- **Evolomino** — place squares along pre-drawn arrows forming blocks that grow by one cell each step

---

### C. Cell Shading / Painting
*Determine which cells are black (shaded) and which are white.*

#### i. Shading with Number Clues Counting Adjacent/Nearby Black Cells
- **Akari** — place light bulbs in white cells; numbered black squares specify adjacent bulb count; all white cells illuminated; no bulb sees another
- **Kurotto** — numbers in circles give sum of sizes of orthogonally adjacent black groups
- **Kurodoko** — numbers give total visible white cells in four directions until a black cell or edge
- **Usowan** — numbers give adjacent black cell counts, but exactly one number per bold-line room is wrong

#### ii. Shading with Room/Region Count Constraints
- **Heyawake** — rooms with numeric shading counts; no 2+ room white horizontal/vertical stretch; black cells don't touch; white cells connected
- **Nurikabe** — numbered white islands of given sizes separated by a connected black wall; no 2×2 black
- **Nurimisaki** — circle cells are white promontories (one white neighbor); numbers give line length from promontory; no 2×2 same color; white connected
- **Nurimeizu** — rooms entirely shaded or white; create a maze from S to G; circles on shortest path, triangles not; no 2×2 same color
- **Nuritwin** — each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; blocks in same region don't touch; all shaded connected; no 2×2 shaded
- **Norinori** — each bold-line region has exactly two shaded cells forming dominoes (pairs of adjacent black cells)
- **LITS** — shade a tetromino in each region; same-shape tetrominoes don't touch (except diagonally); shaded connected; no 2×2 shaded
- **Sto-stone** — shade cells in rooms (number gives count); black cells don't connect across room borders; when "dropped" they fill bottom half of grid

#### iii. Shading with Shape Constraints on Black/White Groups
- **Choco Banana** — black groups must form rectangles/squares; white groups must NOT form rectangles/squares; numbers give group size
- **Shakashaka** — place triangles in white cells so remaining white areas form rectangles/squares; numbers on black cells count adjacent triangles

#### iv. Shading with Connectivity/Uniqueness Constraints
- **Hitori** — shade duplicate numbers so no number repeats in any row/column; black cells don't touch; white cells connected
- **Chained Block** — shade cells into "blocks"; each block contains one number (= block size) or "?"; all blocks must be in a diagonal chain; no duplicate size+shape within a chain

#### v. Shading Entire Tiles
- **Tilepaint** — bold-line tiles are entirely shaded or unshaded; diagonal-cell numbers specify black cell counts in rows/columns

---

### D. Region Division / Partitioning
*Divide the grid into regions/blocks by drawing borders.*

#### i. Partition into Regions with Number Constraints
- **Shikaku** — divide into rectangles; each contains exactly one number equal to its area
- **Five Cells** — divide into pentominoes (5-cell blocks); numbers show how many block borders surround that cell (including outer frame)
- **Fillomino** — fill grid with numbers and partition into blocks; each block's cells all contain the same number equal to the block's size; same-size blocks cannot touch
- **Sashigane** — divide into L-shaped blocks (one cell wide); circles mark bends with optional size numbers; arrows mark ends pointing toward the bend

#### ii. Partition into Paired/Matching Regions
- **Double Choco** — divide grid into blocks; each block has matching white and gray sub-regions of identical shape; numbers indicate count of that color in the block

---

### E. Number/Symbol Placement
*Fill cells with numbers or symbols subject to constraints.*

#### i. Latin-Square Style
- **Sudoku** — place 1–9 in each cell; no repeats in any row, column, or 3×3 box

#### ii. Room-Based Number Fill
- **Makaro** — fill rooms with 1 to N (N = room size); arrow cells point to the largest neighbor; same numbers can't be adjacent across rooms
- **Ripple Effect** — fill rooms with 1 to N; if a number k appears twice in same row/column, they must be ≥ k cells apart

#### iii. Number Placement from a Given List
- **Nansuke** — fill blank cells with digits to form numbers from a given list, reading left-to-right or top-to-bottom

#### iv. Symbol Placement (Non-numeric)
- **Juosan** — fill every cell with — or |; territory numbers constrain the difference in counts; no 3+ consecutive — vertically or | horizontally

#### v. Sequential Number Placement
- **Hebi** — place snake segments 1 (head) to 5 (tail) sequentially connected; snakes can't touch; line-of-sight from head cannot see another snake

---

### F. Object Movement
*Move given objects within the grid.*

- **Satogaeri** — move numbered circles vertically/horizontally so each bold-line country has exactly one circle; number = distance moved; paths can't cross
- **Yosenabe** — move all circles into gray areas via straight arrows; arrows can't cross or pass through other circles; gray area numbers = sum of entering circle values

---

## II. Cross-Cutting Dimensions

### By Clue Mechanism
| Mechanism | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Clues count adjacent features** | Akari, Kurotto, Shakashaka, Usowan, Slitherlink, Five Cells |
| **Clues count features in a direction/line** | Kurodoko, Yajilin, Nurimisaki, Hebi, Tilepaint, Juosan |
| **Clues give region/block size** | Shikaku, Fillomino, Choco Banana, Nurikabe, Nuritwin, Norinori, Heyawake, Sto-stone, LITS, Double Choco, Chained Block, Sashigane, Five Cells, Pencils |
| **Clues give total/sum** | Yosenabe, Kurotto, Hashiwokakero |
| **Clues specify order/sequence** | Suraromu, Hebi, Evolomino |
| **Clues specify direction** | Makaro, Yajilin, Hebi, Nagareru, Sashigane, Pencils, Yosenabe |
| **Clues constrain turning/straightness** | Masyu, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop |
| **Clues involve distance/separation** | Ripple Effect, Satogaeri, Kurodoko, Nurimisaki |
| **One clue per region is false** | Usowan |

### By Global Structural Constraint
| Constraint | Puzzles |
|---|---|
| **Single closed loop** | Masyu, Slitherlink, Mid-loop, Dotchi-Loop, Moon-or-Sun, Nagareru, Suraromu, Yajilin |
| **All white/unshaded cells connected** | Hitori, Heyawake, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Usowan, Nurimeizu |
| **All shaded cells connected** | Nurikabe (black wall), LITS, Nuritwin |
| **No 2×2 same-color block** | Nurikabe, LITS, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, Sto-stone |
| **Black cells don't touch orthogonally** | Hitori, Heyawake, Yajilin, Usowan, Kurodoko |
| **Complete grid coverage (partition)** | Shikaku, Five Cells, Fillomino, Sashigane, Double Choco, Sudoku |
| **Gravity/dropping** | Sto-stone |
| **Shape matching within blocks** | Double Choco, Chained Block, Nuritwin |
| **All islands/nodes connected (graph)** | Hashiwokakero |
| **Paths don't cross** | Numberlink, Satogaeri, Yosenabe, Pencils |
